environment: Owned disposable local Docker Redis 7.4; Medusa 2.21.2, Mercur 2.3.7, BullMQ 5.13.0; shared API and four workers

method.baseline: Same frozen workload and five source-file overlays, owned Redis DB15 cleared and its container restarted before each run; new PostgreSQL fixture database per run.
method.requests: ioredis5/6 serialized requests, validated against a short MONITOR calibration; socket failure can prevent delivery. Not cloud billing.
method.executedCalls: Redis INFO deltas include Lua internal calls; two observer commands excluded per window.
method.tails: Post-action drain windows include native asynchronous work AND diagnostic queue probes. Do not treat them as pure production traffic.
method.resources: CPU and network include observer overhead; memory is a gauge. Latencies are single local samples, not a controlled performance benchmark.
method.projection: Linear projection of the measured 130-second idle window only, shared mode with empty business fixtures; excludes traffic and unobserved 15/30-minute jobs. Not Railway usage or cost.
